skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply principles of business management in agricultural contexts.
Analyze and manage financial aspects of agricultural businesses.
Identify and manage risks in agricultural operations.
Develop and optimize supply chain processes in agriculture.
Apply leadership skills in agricultural business settings.
Implement quality control measures in agricultural production.
Solve business problems using analytical techniques.
Effectively communicate business ideas and solutions.
Work effectively in teams to achieve business goals.
Evaluate business decisions critically and logically.
Take initiative and responsibility in business contexts.
Commit to ongoing learning and development in agriculture.
